name: Gayatree G Lahon

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Gayatree G Lahon is a poet and teacher from Assam. Her contributor biographies record postgraduate study in English literature at Gauhati University and publication in literary journals and anthologies, including GloMag and Our Poetry Archive.

In ‘Trees Sing’, her poem in Kabita Live, listening becomes a way of recovering an inner life. Leaves, breeze and imagined song answer the speaker’s numbness, while the poem questions a world too occupied with possessions to hear either nature or itself. Its movement from emptiness towards solace rests on quiet, attentive observation.
